display_name: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
notes: Camera struct base in rdi at activecam_write intercept. 4x4 rotation matrix at +0x10/+0x20/+0x30 (movaps rows 1-3, 16 bytes each), XYZ coords at +0x40, FOV at +0x58.

intercepts.name: activecam_address
intercepts.description: Camera struct address capture -- mov rax,[rsi+28h] loads camera ptr into rax before matrix copy loop.

intercepts.name: activecam_write
intercepts.description: Camera matrix rows 1-3 + XYZ coord write. rdi = camera struct destination. NOP to freeze camera.

intercepts.name: fov_write
intercepts.description: FOV write (movss [rcx+??],xmm1 x4). NOP first 5 bytes to freeze FOV.
